source_issue.title: Polish documentation renames, and overall shape

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on polishing the documentation for the Plone Aurora project, especially following significant renaming changes made in [pull request #100](https://github.com/plone/aurora/pull/100). The goal is to ensure that the documentation reflects the current state and correct terminology.

## What needs to be done
- Revise the "Contributing..." section, which still contains elements from the earlier Volto documentation. 
- Correct any outdated terms, such as "Seven," that may still appear.
- Ensure that all sections are clear and accurately represent the project's current status.

## Helpful background
The documentation can be found [here](https://plone-aurora.readthedocs.io/). It’s important for contributors to have clear guidance, particularly in sections related to contributing to the project. Review the existing content for any areas that might still misrepresent the intended direction.

## Good first steps
1. Review the current documentation and identify sections that need updates, especially under "Contributing...".
2. Look out for outdated terms or references that need correction.
3. Share your findings in a comment or submit a pull request with your proposed changes.

Feel free to reach out if you have questions or need help!
```
